execution_precondition: Run from the discovery project directory: prior checkpoint bindings use project-relative .cache paths. Pin the reviewed script/scope before the single recorded invocation; do not import/run against a different source.

resolved_findings.resolution: The final source reads scope-bound prior artifacts and checks exact length/SHA256 before SOURCE.read_bytes. Mismatch exits PRIOR_CHECKPOINT_IDENTITY_BLOCKED; the preserved-failure assertion is therefore conditional on that guard. The code only writes new comparison-directory outputs.
A fixed emitted cell_count_scope states that counters include the header and empty cells in eleven-column records only, excluding other widths. Scope adds the same distinction.

unchanged_limits: Only strict cp1252 and strict iso8859-1 are attempted; no detection/winner, fallback replacement, normalization, alias merge or unit conversion.
Complete source bytes, both successful hypothetical decoded texts and all parsed cells may be machine exposed, including examples/options/comments. No untouched/blind evidence claim.
Semicolon csv.reader with explicit quote/doublequote/noescape/strict and StringIO(newline="") preserves CR/LF framing without Unicode NEL splitlines behavior.
Both exact headers and structural record spans/widths must agree before projection. Unknown/nonASCII/different cells remain unbound, even if the hypotheses return the same nonASCII string.
Examples-column values are always omitted from internal selected-cell text. ASCII comments are permitted internally and may contain empirical examples; they are explicitly not public output.

Closed public output contains identity, stage/status, structural counters and locators only. Complete selected ASCII strings are written only to ignored internal-ascii-projection.json and are not printed.
No formulas, links, secondary objects, network, measurement files, scientific units, model/protocol criteria or benchmark admission are implemented.
interpretation_caveats: Structural agreement is expected to be weak evidence between ASCII-compatible single-byte codecs with ASCII CSV syntax; it is not encoding identification or validation of the full scientific meanings.

ASCII invariance establishes textual agreement only. The code does not establish semantic independence from a nonASCII/unknown neighboring cell; researcher claims must retain those dependencies as unbound.
csv strict mode is the specifically scoped Python csv.reader behavior, not a separately proven complete general CSV grammar.
Actual hypothesis success, counts and exposure must come from the later recorded invocation; this review provides none of those observations.
delta_check: Compared initial/final exact source and scope. Only prior-binding guard and counter-denominator statement were added to source; scope algorithm/script identity/refinement metadata changed accordingly. Initial finding/source/scope snapshots remain preserved.

actual_review_activity.method: Static source/scope inspection and exact documentary delta/hash checks only.
